text:
Hey!
Are you new to Bingo?
zh:
嘿！
你是第一次玩宾果吗？

text: If you want, I can explain the game mode to you.
zh: 如果你愿意，我可以给你讲讲这个游戏模式。

text: How can I keep track of the goals?
zh: 我要怎么追踪这些目标？

text: Do you have any questions about Bingo?
zh: 关于宾果，你还有什么问题吗？

text: At the start of the game, you'll get a handful of random objectives to complete.
zh: 游戏开始时，你会得到一些随机目标去完成。

text: Simply press ###input.INPUT_GAME_MODE_SPECIAL### to view the Bingo Board and your objectives.
zh: 只需按下###input.INPUT_GAME_MODE_SPECIAL###即可查看宾果板和你的目标。

text: As soon as you completed a Bingo Goal, open the Bingo Board and mark it.
zh: 一旦完成某个宾果目标，就打开宾果板把它标记上。

text: A Bingo is achieved by marking all goals in a vertical, horizontal or diagonal line.
zh: 把竖排、横排或对角线上的所有目标都标记完成，即可达成一次宾果。

text: You can favor Bingo Goals to easily find certain goals on the Bingo Board.
zh: 你可以收藏宾果目标，方便在宾果板上快速找到特定目标。

text: Also, you're able to add counters to your goals to track progress as you work toward a set amount.
zh: 此外，你还可以给目标添加计数器，在朝着设定数量努力时随时掌握进度。
